title: Delegate RecipeScale to Recipe.scaled(by:)
description: Refactor the existing app-layer RecipeScale wrapper so its recipe-scaling path delegates to the new CookbookCore helper without changing existing discrete-scale behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Existing RecipeScale public behavior remains equivalent for its supported enum factors.
No duplicate scaling logic remains in RecipeScale once delegation is introduced.

handoff_summary.completed: Replaced the 14-line ingredient-mapping body of `RecipeScale.scaled(_ recipe:)` with a single `recipe.scaled(by: factor)` delegation call. Removed the `scaled(_ quantity: Quantity) -> Quantity` helper that was only ever called by that body.
handoff_summary.risks: None. The delegation preserves identical behaviour: `Recipe.scaled(by:)` applies the same factor to numeric quantities only, leaves text quantities and missing quantities unchanged, and reconstructs the Recipe with the same metadata/sections/cookware/timers.
handoff_summary.next_action: Route to tester agent for verification of scaling behaviour across the four RecipeScale enum cases.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. Only `RecipeScale.swift` was modified. No sibling beads touch this file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Removed `scaled(_ quantity: Quantity)` entirely rather than leaving it as dead code. It was private and only called by the old `scaled(_ recipe:)` body, so removal is safe and keeps the file clean.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify all four scale factors (0.5×, 1×, 2×, 3×) produce correct ingredient quantities, that text-valued quantities pass through unchanged, and that nil quantities are preserved. Callers in `AddToShoppingListService` and `IngredientsView` should be smoke-tested.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The SourceKit `No such module 'CookbookCore'` diagnostic is pre-existing in the worktree environment (the import was there before this bead) and does not indicate a real build failure.

conflict_risks: None. Only `RecipeScale.swift` was modified. No sibling beads touch this file.

execution_history.summary: Refactored `RecipeScale.scaled(_ recipe:)` to delegate to the new `Recipe.scaled(by: factor)` CookbookCore helper. Removed the now-dead `scaled(_ quantity:)` private helper. All public-facing methods and signatures are unchanged.
